sources.title: Naga City Investment and Tourism Promotions Office: Malabsay Falls
sources.note: Panicuason, Mt. Isarog Natural Park, approximately 40-foot drop and receiving pond. Access times, fees and hours are not asserted.

text.en: Malabsay Falls is in Panicuason, Naga City.
The falls lie within Mt. Isarog Natural Park.
Naga City Tourism describes the drop as about 40 feet high (roughly 12 metres).
The falling water collects in a pond at the base.
